headline: Your unique learning journey—celebrating how far you've come and where you're going
universal_truth: Every learning journey is unique; your path is yours to define and celebrate
fun_facts: Your learning history is a record of curiosity in action
Looking back at progress is one of the most effective motivation techniques
The topics you've engaged with reveal your evolving interests
discussion_questions: What themes emerge from your learning journey?
Which lessons have stuck with you most?
Where do you want your learning to take you next?

hook.script: Let's take a moment to see your learning journey as a whole. The lessons you've completed, the topics you've explored, the time you've invested. This is your learning biography.

cliff.script: Is looking at your past learning really that valuable?

options.text: Your history reveals patterns—what interests you, when you learn best, how you've grown; understanding your journey helps you continue it intentionally
options.response: Yes. Your learning history is data about yourself. What topics keep appearing? When do you engage most? Seeing patterns helps you learn more effectively.
The past informs the future. Understanding how you've learned helps you learn better going forward...

fact1.title: Your Topics
fact1.script: Look at the lessons you've completed. What themes emerge? Science? Philosophy? Relationships? Your choices reveal your evolving curiosity. What patterns do you notice?

fact2.title: Your Consistency
fact2.script: When have you been most consistent? What helps you show up? What breaks your streak? Understanding your patterns of engagement helps you design for success.

fact3.title: Your Next Chapter
fact3.script: Where do you want to go next? What gaps exist? What topics call you? Use your history to inform your intentions. The next chapter of your journey is yours to write.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Your learning journey is uniquely yours. No one else has the same path. Honor where you've been as you continue forward.

outro.script: You're doing something remarkable—investing in yourself daily. Whatever your stats show, the commitment itself is the achievement. Keep going.

growTrack.title: Journey Mapping - Chart Your Path
growTrack.learning_objective: Reflect on and plan your learning journey
growTrack.activity: Review your completed lessons. Note themes that interest you most. Identify gaps you want to fill. Set an intention for your next phase of learning. Your journey is yours to design.
